notInstalled.title: Novera igqiba imisebenzi kwibrawuza yakho
notInstalled.description: Faka ulwandiso ukunika i-Novera ukufikelela kwisikhangeli

deleteServer.title: Cima iseva ye-MCP
deleteServer.description: Ngaba uqinisekile ukuba ufuna ukucima i MCP iseva {{serverName}}? Esi senzo asinakuphinda singenziwa.

editJson.title: Hlela i-JSON ye-MCP iseva: {{serverName}}
editJson.errorServerName: Igama leseva liyafuneka kwaye alinakungabi nanto
editJson.errorMissingServerNameKey: JSON kufuneka yakhiwe njenge {"serverName": {config}} - iqhosha legama lomncedisi elilahlekileyo
editJson.errorInvalidType: Uhlobo olungasebenziyo '{{type}}' kumncedisi '{{serverName}}'. Uhlobo kufuneka lube 'stdio', 'http', okanye 'sse'

title: MCP iiseva
allowPermissionsDesc: Xa yenziwe yasebenza, zonke iifowuni ze-MCP zesixhobo ziya kuvunywa ngokuzenzekelayo ngaphandle kokubonisa iingxoxo zemvume. Olu seto lusebenza kwihlabathi liphela kuzo zonke iincoko, kuquka neengxoxo ezintsha.

runtimeSettings.title: Iisetingi zeXesha lokuSebenza
runtimeSettings.description: Qwalasela indlela i-Novera elawula ngayo kwaye uzame kwakhona iiseva ze-MCP.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Elona xesha liphezulu lokulinda impendulo yesixhobo ye-MCP ngaphambi kokuphela kwexesha.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Esona sixhobo side sigcinwe kwincoko. Nantoni na edlulileyo iyasikwa kwaye iphawulwe njengencitshisiwe, ke isiphumo esinye esikhulu asikwazi ukuwugqiba umxholo wemodeli. Cwangcisa ku-0 ukugcina iziphumo ziphelele.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: Xa yenziwe, i-Novera ikhetha iiseva ezifanelekileyo ze-MCP ngaphambi kokulayisha izixhobo. Khubaza ukusoloko ulayisha uluhlu olupheleleyo lwezixhobo ze-MCP.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: Xa i-smart routing ivuliwe, sebenzisa inyathelo lendlela ngemodeli eyahlukileyo (ehlala incinci) endaweni yemodeli yencoko. Cima ukuze uhlale usebenzisa imodeli yencoko esebenzayo yomzila.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Khetha umboneleli kunye nemodeli kwindawo enye. Iimodeli ezikhaphukhaphu kuphela ezidwelisiweyo ukuze indlela ihlale ikhawuleza kwaye inexabiso eliphantsi.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: Akukho zimodeli zikhaphukhaphu zikhoyo. Yongeza imodeli encinci okanye uqwalasele izitshixo ze-API kwiiModeli.
